notes.title: Firefight! ~ Version 2.0.0 is here!
notes.notes:
[i]Firefight![/i] (our very first GameMaker game) is BACK with a brand-new update!

Thanks to the fact that we've set out to port [i]Firefight![/i] to consoles, we decided to beef up the game with a ton of new features! Check out everything waiting for you in version 2.0.0...

[list]
[*] Updated for 60fps gameplay!
[*] New "near-miss" score points, and water shields!
[*] "Randomized Gameplay" is now toggleable in the menu options, to make your "Firefight!" gameplay behave deterministically for that flawless speedrun you're dying to make!
[*] "Classic Mode" menu option that lets you play "Firefight!" as it was in the old, pre-2.0.0 era, without all the gameplay bells and whistles!
[*] New particle effects!
[*] Improved pause menu with a new scorecard to help track your progress through the game
[*] Additional localizations to Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish
[/list]

Last but not least, we're happy to report that the game is [b]fully compatible with the Steam Deck[/b]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36511436/d81b4a46f718fa9ac7183019b24c8b0f7f637dfb.png[/img]

Now you can take [i]Firefight![/i] with you wherever you go!

notes.title: Firefight! Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[i]Firefight![/i] is back with a brand-spanking-new patch! The game now has such exciting features as:

[list]
[*] Internationalized text! Play the game in Spanish, French, German, or Italian! Or just boring old English.
[*] We finally got around to adding Steam achievements!
[*] A handful of small, annoying bugs were also fixed.
[/list]
